headline: Last session: Sensex snapped winning streak, falling 319 points as Nifty ended below 25,150 on inflation worries.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on investor sentiment during the last trading session.
Benchmark indices snapped their winning streak with Sensex dropping over 300 points.
Key financial and retail stocks faced selling pressure, pulling Nifty below 25,150.
JLR slashed its margin guidance to 2-3%, impacting broader auto sector expectations.
whatHappening: Sensex fell 319 points while Nifty50 ended at 25,144 on the last trading day.
Shriram Finance emerged as a top loser, and Manappuram Finance fell 4%.
HDFC Bank and Titan Company traded lower as top laggards during the session.
Indian markets still managed to close higher for the third straight week overall.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian stock markets closed lower as inflation worries snapped their winning streak, sending Sensex down 319 points and Nifty below 25,150. Heavy selling in financials and auto stocks dragged sentiment despite market gains across the broader week. Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
